text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how long you have noticed this breast mass and if you have experienced any pain or skin changes?

text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the mass been associated with any skin changes like redness, dimpling, or ulceration, and have you noticed any nipple discharge or retraction? Also, is there a family history of breast or ovarian cancer?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass.

speaker: Doctor
text: Is the mass fixed to the underlying tissue or movable, and does it feel hard or rubbery to the touch? I would also like to know if you are currently post-menopausal or if you are taking any hormone replacement therapy.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. No family history of breast cancer. Social history: Non-smoker, moderate alcohol use. Elementary school teacher.

speaker: Doctor
